C1.metric: max relative deviation of C_T from Garrick closed form over 9 points
C1.note: net C_T is drag-dominated at h0/c=0.02 (C_D0 ~ 0.177), so the increment dC_T = C_T(flap) - C_T(locked) is the physically comparable quantity; both are reported

C1_big.note: large amplitude: net thrust is O(0.1) so the 15% band is meaningful

C2.note: Garrick eta(k) for the C2 configuration is monotone in k over [0.5,2], so no interior peak exists to locate; the criterion is reported as trend + amplitude agreement at matched k

C3.note: analytic side; the LBM cannot reach k<0.2 within the step budget

C4.note: budget W_body = dKE + Phi_visc + F_boundary.  The open-domain cases carry the pressure work of the velocity-inlet/sponge-outlet boundary (F_boundary >> W_body), so only the closed periodic box is a clean test of the accounting; both dissipation estimators (2 nu S:S and the discrete -Pi_neq:grad u) are reported

C5.note: analytic reversal line computed with the measured drag C_D0 of the same geometry/Re (0.177) gives h0/c_crit = 0.216, St_crit = 0.138; the LBM crossing case at h0/c=0.25 checks the predicted sign flip. C_T(St) is monotone INCREASING, not decreasing: the task wording is inverted w.r.t. the physics (thrust grows with St, reversal at low St)

C6.note: error ratio of dC_T with respect to the Garrick value; the drag baseline C_D0 cancels in the increment
